name: ANSI/IEEE circuit breaker symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for circuit breaker, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The breaker representation identifies the interrupting device in an IEEE-oriented schematic library. Follow its two power connections before interpreting the operating or protection annotation; auxiliary contacts and trip coils belong to separately linked circuits.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: A one-line breaker endpoint does not expose every pole of the physical device.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: The graphical breaker reference identifies equipment; ANSI device number 52 identifies an AC circuit-breaker function and is not a substitute glyph.
